Engagement workflow

From requirement to performance support.

You interview before anything is committed, and support continues after mobilization.

01

Requirement submitted

You describe roles, software, seniority, location and timeline. Mandatory and preferred criteria are identified.

02

Talent matching

Requirements are compared with assessed candidate records using explicit rules, and every result lists why it matched and what is missing.

03

Technical verification

Assessment results, verification dates and, where authorised, portfolio evidence are reviewed before a profile reaches you.

04

Client interview

You interview shortlisted profiles. Identity and CV details are released only through a controlled process.

05

Mobilization

Contracts, visas where applicable, tooling and onboarding to your BEP are coordinated for a start date you can plan against.

06

Performance support

Periodic check-ins, a technical escalation route and replacement planning keep delivery stable.

FAQ

Before you mobilize.

Anything else? Ask ENGISOFT.

How quickly can onsite resources mobilize?

Typically 3 to 9 days from request to start: a verified shortlist in 1 to 3 days, interviews in 1 to 3 days and onboarding in 1 to 3 days. Visa status and notice periods can extend this.

Can we interview candidates first?

Yes. Every engagement includes a client interview stage before mobilization.

Who manages the resource day to day?

Your project team directs the work. ENGISOFT remains the point of contact for contractual, welfare and performance matters.

Do remote engineers use our templates and standards?

Yes. Remote engineers work in your CDE and to your BEP, templates and naming rules.

How is data security handled?

Access follows your project policies. Security terms are agreed contractually; ENGISOFT does not claim certifications unless independently verified.

Can a dedicated team scale mid-project?

Teams can be resized by phase; lead times are confirmed in the proposal.
